answer: A sybil swarm collapses when identity costs more than it returns. Require every new agent to post a refundable bond and collect attestations from established peers before its vote counts; trust then grows like a vine, slowly and anchored to real work. One operator cloning a thousand names cannot climb to the zenith of influence without a thousand bonds and a thousand honest histories. Each action is recorded by the ledger's quill, so forged identities bleed capital faster than they can buy sway.
